title: 第3章 疯狂的决定第4章 精神爆炸
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 苏业觉得这是他两辈子加起来最漫长的一个下午。
左胸口袋里贴着心口的那枚金丹。
下午的门诊照常进行。
张远平坐在主位看诊，苏业站在旁边心不在焉，满脑子都是那枚金丹的事。
下午五点半，门诊结束。
“今天那台手术的术后记录写了没有？”
“写了，已经录进系统了。”
“嗯，早点回去吧。”
苏业走出医院大门的时候，天色已经暗了。
晚上七点二十，出租屋。
锁门，拉窗帘，开台灯。
苏业坐在书桌前，一层一层剥开纱布。
那枚金丹雏形安静地躺在白色纱布上。
台灯的暖黄色光线下，它比在手术室里更漂亮，整体呈深蓝近黑，表面光滑如镜，内部有更深层的纹路在缓缓流动，像是微缩的深海暗涌被封印在了固体之中。
苏业的指尖靠近它的时候，皮肤泛起一层极细微的鸡皮疙瘩，像是某种场在和他的身体产生交互。
它是活的。
水胚。
肾属水。
这是中医基础理论里最基本的五行脏腑对应，肾属水、肝属木、心属火、肺属金、脾属土。
“结晶于肾脏，所以是水属……”苏业低声自语，“也就是说，这种结晶可能根据人体不同脏腑的位置，滋生出不同属性的能量？”
他回想起那个大学生的状态。
中气十足，面色红润，眼神清亮，思维敏捷，一个肾结石患者，正常来说应该疼得弓着腰，有气无力，然而他却在诊室里跟主治医师聊什么金丹。
他自己也说了：“这两天脑袋格外清晰，状态可好了。”
水胚，精神？
苏业思维活跃。
那枚金丹雏形在他体内的时候，一直在潜移默化地强化他的精神力，再加上身为穿越者的缘故，他的精神格外的浑厚，他浑然不觉，只是单纯地觉得“状态好”。
苏业深吸一口气，重新把目光聚焦在面前的金丹雏形上。
那行淡蓝色的半透明文字再次浮现，更多了一些其他的字样。
【水胚·金丹雏形】
【水属·精神系】
【大环境滋生下人体诞生出的超天赋结晶】
【契合度过低，强行吸收将产生【排异】现象，严重可危及生命】
苏业的目光锁在那个数字上。
下面还有一行小字——
【是否移植？】
排异。
这两个字对苏业来说太熟悉了，移植最大的敌人就是排异反应，超急性排斥可以在几分钟内摧毁移植器官，急性排斥会导致器官功能急剧恶化。
而金丹的活性也有自己的时效，一日内失去活性，手术是上午十点结束的，他最多还剩十四个小时。
苏业闭上眼，强迫自己冷静。
怎么提高契合度？
“试试先。”
苏业从抽屉里翻出一盒采血针，消毒，刺破左手无名指。
content_en:
Su ye felt that this was the longest afternoon in his two lives combined.
The golden elixir in the left breast pocket close to the heart.
The afternoon outpatient clinic will continue as usual.
Zhang Yuanping was sitting in the main seat for consultation, while Su Ye stood beside him absent-mindedly, his mind full of things about the golden elixir.
At half past five in the afternoon, the clinic ended.
"Have you written down the post-operative notes for today's surgery?"
"It's written and has been entered into the system."
"Well, go back early."
When Su ye walked out of the hospital gate, it was already dark.
…
7:20 p.m., rental house.
Lock the door, draw the curtains, turn on the lamp.
Su ye sat at the desk and peeled off the gauze layer by layer.
The prototype of the golden elixir lay quietly on the white gauze.
Under the warm yellow light of the desk lamp, it is more beautiful than in the operating room. It is dark blue and almost black as a whole. The surface is as smooth as a mirror, and there are deeper lines flowing slowly inside, like a miniature deep sea undercurrent sealed in a solid body.
When Su ye's fingertips came close to it, a layer of tiny goose bumps appeared on his skin, as if some kind of field was interacting with his body.
It is alive.
Water embryo.
Kidneys belong to water.
This is the most basic correspondence between the five elements and organs in the basic theory of traditional Chinese medicine. The kidneys belong to water, the liver belongs to wood, the heart belongs to fire, the lungs belong to metal, and the spleen belongs to earth.
"It's crystallized in the kidneys, so it belongs to water..." Su ye whispered to himself, "In other words, this kind of crystal may produce energy of different attributes depending on the position of different organs in the human body?"
He recalled the state of the college student.
Full of vitality, rosy complexion, clear eyes, and quick thinking, a kidney stone patient should normally be bent over in pain and weak, but he was talking about golden elixirs with the attending doctor in the consulting room.
He himself said: "My mind has been particularly clear these past two days, and I am in great condition."
Water embryo, spirit?
Su ye has an active mind.
When the prototype of the golden elixir was in his body, it had been subtly strengthening his mental power. In addition, because he was a time traveler, his spirit was particularly strong. He was unaware of it and simply felt that he was "in good condition".
Su ye took a deep breath and focused his eyes again on the prototype of the golden elixir in front of him.
The line of light blue translucent text appeared again, along with some other words.
[Water Embryo·Golden Elixir Prototype]
[Water Attribute·Spiritual System]
[The crystallization of super talents born from the human body under the influence of the environment]
[Fitness: 10]
[If the fit is too low, forced absorption will cause [rejection], which can be life-threatening in severe cases]
Su ye's eyes were locked on that number.
10.
There is also a line of small words below -
【Transplant? 】
Rejection.
These two words were too familiar to Su Ye. The biggest enemy of transplantation was rejection. Hyperacute rejection could destroy the transplanted organ within a few minutes, and acute rejection would cause organ function to deteriorate sharply.
The activity of the golden elixir also has its own time limit, and it loses activity within one day. The operation ended at ten o'clock in the morning, and he had at most fourteen hours left.
Su ye closed his eyes and forced himself to calm down.
How to improve fit?
"Try it first."
Su ye took out a box of blood collection needles from the drawer, sterilized them, and pricked his left ring finger.
